name: The Noblest of Creatures: Stray Cat
source:
A broken country of art, love, and beauty with 'Cat' on its coat of arms, a country that lost its nobility after falling to beastly and manly invaders…

An underbelly of an elegant city where dark desires and hatred lived even before the war…

Follow the two different queer noble men lost in an immoral land as 'stray cats' and attempt to change their fates. 

[From [url=https://atomkinema.itch.io/the-noblest-of-creatures-stray-cat]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个破碎的艺术、爱与美的国家，国徽上写着“猫”，一个在被野蛮和男子气概的入侵者占领后失去高贵的国家……

这座优雅城市的底层，在战前就已经存在着黑暗的欲望和仇恨……

跟随两位不同的酷儿贵族，以“流浪猫”的身份迷失在不道德的土地上，并试图改变他们的命运。

[来自[url=https://atomkinema.itch.io/the-noblest-of-creatures-stray-cat]itch.io[/url]]
